attributes.summary: VeritasContentToken: the launched ERC-20. Fixed supply minted once in its constructor to the launcher, no mint/burn/owner/pause/upgrade and no transfer tax, so registerPool's whole-supply check is a real anti-squatting proof. Deployed by the launcher with CREATE2 salted by the attestation id.
VeritasHook: DRS-gated dynamic-fee pool, JIT-proof per-position insurance claims, quadrant-dependent Programmable fee collection.

VeritasLauncher: one transaction mints the content token, registers the pool against its attestation, initializes it and seeds liquidity, or reverts leaving nothing behind. It holds the LP position and exposes no path that removes liquidity, transfers a position or sweeps a balance.
The launcher deploys the content token inside the launch transaction, so its whole supply never sits in an EOA.
The launcher calls registerPool, initialize and modifyLiquidity on the hook's canonical pool in that order, atomically.
The launched token is the pool's content asset; the hook binds it to exactly one attestation, permanently and in both directions.

launchProcedure.atomicStep: VeritasLauncher.launch(LaunchParams) then performs, in one transaction: CREATE2-deploy the content token with its whole supply to the launcher; assert that supply is held; build the canonical dynamic-fee PoolKey with correct currency ordering; registerPool; initialize; pull the quote asset and seed the LP position; assert the pool is registered against this exact attestation, is initialized, and holds the seeded liquidity; refund unused quote.
launchProcedure.custody: The LP position belongs to the launcher, which has no function that removes liquidity, transfers a position, sweeps a balance or upgrades anything. Seeded liquidity is therefore locked at the EVM level.
launchProcedure.liveProof: Executed on Unichain Sepolia: attestation 0x2ba9a49da0e7faa138ee1f1e6c13deaf98ce39240d0f1d86f17e28b5788bf5ed, content token 0xa5cd00BA54D6ca4aD4cB8A19b8fE5217dA8fD3Eb, pool 0xc28c078e606d31610a28b24674655640705cd0b7e533d1ac1a671085abca74f9, then swapped through.
launchProcedure.offGraphPrerequisite: The creator must attest the content and then call VeritasHook.authorizeRegistrar(attestationId, launcher). This cannot be folded into this plan: VeritasRegistry.attest records msg.sender as the owner and derives the attestation id from it, and the oracle signatures behind an attestation are valid for only 10 minutes (VeritasOracle.SIGNATURE_MAX_AGE), so no committed static plan can carry valid ones.
postconditions: seeded liquidity tracked by the hook
no content-token premine held by the caller
launchProcedure.replayProtection: One launch per attestation, enforced twice: VeritasLauncher.launchedToken rejects a second attempt, and the content token is CREATE2-salted by the attestation id so a repeat would collide anyway.
launchProcedure.scope: The quote asset must be an ERC-20; a native-ETH quote is rejected by the launcher rather than half-supported. registerPool itself permits a native quote, so this bounds the launcher, not the hook.
